subject: Procurement kickoff: pre-contract security & PO setup checklist
messages:
From: Emily Carter <emily.carter@heliosinc.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Tom Lacy <tom.lacy@heliosinc.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Jan 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Vendor kickoff: pre-contract security artifacts + PO info

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for the quick intro call earlier. We're ready to move to the procurement stage for the Redwood integration. Before Procurement can issue a PO, they asked us to collect a short set of security/compliance artifacts and vendor setup items. Can you confirm whether you can provide the following by end of day Friday? If anything needs a formal NDA/redaction, flag it and we can route.

Helios onboarding checklist (what we need from Redwood):
- SOC 2 Type II report (most recent) or SOC 2 summary + link to full report
- ISO 27001 certificate (if available)
- Recent pen test letter or attestation (2024/2025)
- DPA template and any standard data handling terms
- Certificate of insurance (cyber liability)
- Completed vendor-setup / W-9 / bank remit form (we'll attach ours)
- Point of contact for compliance follow-up

Also: please confirm your standard PO terms (net30/net45), remit-to details, and whether Redwood requires a counter-signed agreement or if Helios can proceed on Redwood's Master Services Order with an attached PO.

Appreciate it — letting procurement know we'll wait for these artifacts to proceed.

Best,
Emily Carter
Procurement Manager, Helios Inc.
emily.carter@heliosinc.com
Phone: +1 415-555-0199

--
Attachment: vendor-setup-form-Helios.pdf (1 page PDF - Helios vendor form)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Emily Carter <emily.carter@heliosinc.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Jan 2026 11:08:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Vendor kickoff: pre-contract security artifacts + PO info

Hi Emily — thanks for the checklist and the call earlier.

We can provide everything on your list. To speed things up I attached a short package: SOC 2 Type II executive summary (redacted), our 2025 pen test letter, and ISO 27001 certificate image. For full SOC 2 evidence we typically send a secure link to a redacted report under an NDA; if Helios needs the unredacted report we can route through Legal.

Quick answers to your procurement questions:
- Standard payment terms: Net 30 (we can discuss Net 45 for enterprise contracts)
- Remit-to: Redwood Inference, 1200 Market St, San Francisco, CA — bank details will be provided on the vendor setup PDF (see attachment)
- Agreement: We have a standard Master Services Agreement (MSA). For this engagement we can accept a PO referencing the MSA (preferred) or sign Helios' SOW — whichever Procurement prefers.

Next steps I propose:
1) I will upload the redacted SOC 2 summary + pen test + ISO cert to a secure Drive folder and share the link to your procurement team.
2) Please return the completed Helios vendor-setup form and W-9 back to me.
3) Rishi (cc'd) will confirm whether Legal needs to review Helios' PO terms or whether we can proceed under our MSA.

Attachments: Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_summary_redacted.pdf; Redwood_PenTest_Letter_2025.pdf; Redwood_ISO27001_certificate.png

Signatures:
Marissa Cole
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
Phone: +1 415-555-0112

From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Jan 2026 12:45:00 -08:00
Subject: Fw: Vendor kickoff: pre-contract security artifacts + PO info

Marissa / Team —

FYI, quick legal notes on evidence and onboarding:
- SOC 2: the summary is fine for Procurement's gating; if Helios requests an unredacted report we'll need an NDA and an access log.
- DPA: we should offer our standard DPA (I'll attach the template when I finish redlining).
- Data residency: confirm whether Helios needs EU-only processing (they indicated US in the call). If they require EU residency, we need to flag for Architecture.
- PO terms: aim to accept a PO that references our MSA. If Helios has custom indemnity clauses, Legal will take a look but that will add time.

I'll prepare the DPA and return it by EOD.

-Nikhil
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

- DocuSign: please confirm if Redwood will countersign our PO via DocuSign or if you prefer us to issue a PO and get signature on the MSA. I've included a DocuSign link below for the PO path.
